title: Kesha Announces 2026 The Freedom World Tour: ‘We Have Survived. Now We Get To Be Free’
summary: Chromeo will join the singer on the 25-date North American run, with Sizzy Rocket, Meek and Erika Jayne along on other dates.
contentText:
Kesha just wrapped the final U.K. dates of her cheekily titled T–s Out tour. And though she’s just days removed from winding down that nearly one-year outing, on Monday morning (March 23) the “Joyride” singer announced her next major road trip, The Freedom Tour .

The run is slated to kick off on May 23 in Chula Vista, Calif. at the North Island Credit Union Amphitheatre and hit Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Kansas City and Toronto before heading overseas for a handful of U.K. and Ireland dates and then returning for a second round of North American shows slated to wrap-up on August 30 at Ruoff Music Center in Noblesville, Ind.

A press release announcing the shows promises that more than a concert, the Freedom Tour is a “declaration. After years of transformation, healing, and creative rebirth, Kesha   is stepping into a new era — one defined by radical self-expression, spiritual resilience, and rebellious joy.  The Freedom Tour  will bring fans into a high-voltage world where glitter meets grit, pop anthems meet spiritual awakening, and survival becomes a celebration.”

Tickets for the Live Nation-promoted tour will go on sale beginning with a Citi presale launching on Tuesday (March 24) at 10 a.m. local time through 10 p.m. local time here , followed by an artist presale on Wednesday (March 25) at 10 a.m. local time. More presales will run throughout the week ahead of a general on sale beginning at 10 a.m. local time on Friday (March 27); for ticketing information click here .

“This summer we are reclaiming our bodies, our voices, and our joy. We have survived. Now we get to be free. Let’s be free together. I want to know what freedom feels like, with all of you,” Kesha said in a statement. “I’ve lived through the fire. This tour is about what comes after. Freedom isn’t just leaving something behind — it’s discovering that what you have lived through has made you magnificently who you are.”

Following the release of last year’s . (Period) , album through her independent Kesha Records, the release noted that Kesha is planning to release new music later this year.

Chromeo will support Kesha on al 25 North American shows, with Sizzy Rocket, Meek and Erika Jayne opening on select dates.
